> **Note**: Current translations are AI-assisted (DeepL) and in beta. We welcome all corrections, big or small!

## Translation Type

- [ ] Report error in existing translation (most common)
- [ ] Propose new language translation
- [ ] Improve existing translation
- [ ] Offer to review a full translation

## Language

**Language:** <!-- e.g., "French", "Korean", "Spanish" -->

**Language Code:** <!-- e.g., "fr", "ko", "es" -->

---

## For Reporting Translation Errors

**File:** <!-- e.g., "doc/C2PA_Specification_zh-Hans.pdf" -->

**Page/Section:** <!-- e.g., "Page 42, Section 3.2" -->

**Current (Incorrect) Text:**
```
[paste current text here]
```

**Suggested Correction:**
```
[paste corrected text here]
```

**Explanation:**
<!-- Why is the current translation incorrect? -->

---

## For Proposing New Translation

**Target Language:** <!-- e.g., "Korean (한국어)" -->

**Translation Scope:**
- [ ] Full C2PA Specification (doc/C2PA_Specification.pdf)
- [ ] README.md
- [ ] faq.md
- [ ] quick-start.md
- [ ] Other (specify: )

**Your Qualifications:**
- **Native speaker:** [ ] Yes [ ] No
- **Technical background:** [ ] Yes [ ] No
- **Translation experience:** <!-- Brief description -->

**Timeline:**
<!-- How long will the translation take? e.g., "2-4 weeks" -->

**Collaboration:**
- [ ] I will translate independently
- [ ] I need a reviewer (native speaker)
- [ ] I can collaborate with others

**Resources:**
- [ ] I have access to translation tools
- [ ] I can create a glossary of technical terms
- [ ] I will follow the translation guidelines in CONTRIBUTING.md
